title: The Show
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about plays made of monsters. Little actors wait behind a stage curtain; when the level starts, each peeks out, walks in, says hello and walks off, one act becoming the next. Then a cameo waves hello once and is gone. The show never waits for you, so a door after the stage plays it again. Signs in the levels say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change who becomes whom.

box.tagline: Be there when the curtain moves.
box.back: A small explorer in a gold beanie finds a stage in a meadow. Two friends wait behind its curtains, and when the level starts, so does their play: each act is a monster that becomes the next. A cameo says hello once and goes. Nothing waits for the hero, so there is an encore door. Open the game in Game-Maker to change the acts.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
A play is a chain of monsters, each becoming the next
Made to be copied and taken apart
